styleLock.direction: high-contrast home-gym strength equipment commerce with clean light spec panels
styleLock.backgroundSystem: cinematic near-black #111315 home-gym for hero and scene shots, seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshots and structure diagrams, light mist grey #F1F3F5 for infographic and spec panels, one cyan accent panel #17A2D6 reserved for the closing shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: cool directional studio key from the upper left with controlled speculars on matte-black steel and soft contact shadows, 5500K soft window light in lifestyle shots, highlights on the beaded upholstery always kept under control
styleLock.surfaceSystem: textured dark rubber gym matting #1A1C1F, matte light-grey board #F1F3F5, smooth polished concrete #2A2D31
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines 28-48pt with charcoal text #2B2F33, thin light-weight numerals for dimension callouts, subtitles 16-20pt, labels 10-14pt
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line leader lines with small dot endpoints and small rounded cyan info chips in the single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: stable front 3/4 hero angle and scale for full-product shots; all steel tubes, pad edges and seat lines must stay perfectly straight; pad seams stay parallel to the frame
noDrift: no warped or bent frame lines
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent high-contrast home-gym strength-equipment visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pure white background #FFFFFF, light mist-grey infographic panels #F1F3F5, charcoal text #2B2F33, matte-black equipment #111315 and one cyan accent #17A2D6; cool directional studio lighting with controlled highlights on matte-black steel and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with thin light-weight numerals for dimensions; consistent thin-line leader labels and small rounded cyan info chips; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale with perfectly straight steel tubes and pad edges and fully composed frames; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no warped or bent frame lines.

provenance.notes: 从 14 张爆款哑铃训练凳详情长图切片提炼；已剥离源品牌中英文字标与画面水印、型号编号、二维码与会员促销贴片、模特身高标注及全部原文案；源图的钢管截面尺寸、整机长宽高、垫厚、调节档位等数值与承重表述一律未采信，标注槽位统一由模板文案字段填充且不承诺任何具体数字；材质仅保留通用的颗粒 PU 皮与钢架语言；产品一律以 {product} 占位，人物仅以 generic、背影/肩部裁切描述。
